prompts.forward: Asset: actual usable 2D fighting-game pixel-art animation PNG, TRUE TRANSPARENT background. NEW drawings from scratch, not a repair or deformation of previous animation. Input1 is reference ONLY for Goku visual identity, hair, expressive face, athletic anatomy, orange gi, navy undershirt/belt/wristbands/blue boots with red trim. Input2 is a POSE LAYOUT ONLY: its red and purple skeletons identify different legs/arms and show 8 sequential poses in a 4 columns x 2 rows grid. Paint EIGHT COMPLETE Gokus at exactly those placements and poses; no missing limbs, no clipped hair, hands, boots or belt. Entire head, neck, torso, hips and BOTH legs must be clean continuous complete anatomy in every cell. All 8 face RIGHT. Same proportions and costume across the loop. Camera is fixed side-three-quarter fighting-game view, 130-native-pixel tall character enlarged nearest-neighbor; crisp stepped native pixels, 1px dark outlines, controlled limited palette, angular cloth shading, strong clear face. Match image1's art quality. Live martial guard: both elbows bent, one fist at ribs, other ready near chest/cheek. Small shoulder/hip counterrotation, stable head, bent knees and actual alternate footfalls. Avoid marching knees or a running loop. IMPORTANT draw the NARROW passing poses in cells3 and7, instead of repeating eight wide straddles. Every pose drawn as ONE complete coherent character; no cutouts, grafted heads, warped cloth, protruding triangle/panel seams, pinched limbs, amputated calves or detached boots. Generous transparent margins and clear separation between all sprites, no overlap. No backgrounds, checkerboard painting, text, labels, guide marks, skeletons, drop shadows, floor line, effects, sword or weapon. Native pixel-art sprites, not smooth illustration, 3D, vector or blurry downscaled art. WALK FORWARD cycle, in row-major order: 1 front-foot contact, back foot toe-off; 2 absorb weight with mild knee/pelvis flexion; 3 rear leg passes narrowly under hips while front leg supports; 4 swing foot reaches ahead with small low lift; 5 opposite-leg contact; 6 opposite weight absorption; 7 opposite narrow passing; 8 recovery into first contact. Low cautious fighting stride but agile/energetic, eyes determined. Follow the two skeleton leg positions in each corresponding cell. Upper body must look alive and balanced, not rigid.
